proposal.selection: Independently retain unchanged full-frame plus fixed corner-tile proposals from generic objects and task-class door prompts, then concatenate without NMS or truth filtering.

masker.contract: Apply unchanged native SAM2 once to every retained proposal from both birth channels.

geometry.pair_score: Geometric mean of depth-consistent proposal-mask coverage in both directions.
geometry.candidate_score: Unchanged ranking: depth support, mutual-best support, maximum symmetric track score, objectness and frozen concatenation index.

literature_motivation.name: MV3DIS
literature_motivation.use: Use 3D mask association to arbitrate independently born proposals instead of fusing correlated appearance scores.

gate.requirements: Both initial frames must offer IoU>=0.8 and unchanged 3D-track Top-3 must retain IoU>=0.8.

next_action: Close dual proposal birth as insufficient on row 4 without prompt or threshold sweeps.
claim_boundary: This is posthoc Development on a consumed source family. A pass would show only that independent class-conditioned proposal birth repairs the observed initial opportunity gap while the output budget remains Top-3. It is not fresh confirmation, portal ownership, access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability, deployment, or safety.
